title: Differentiation of glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored prion protein in cancer cells
author: Li, Yang, et al.

steps.title: Sterilize materials and work aseptically
steps.instruction: Sterilize all cell‑culture materials and perform every step in a Level II biosafety cabinet using standard aseptic techniques.

steps.title: Passage cells with Trypsin‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Detach proliferative AsPC‑1 and HLE cells with 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA, split one 10 cm dish into three 6 cm dishes (or two 10 cm dishes) after 2–3 days, and keep total passage number below 10.

steps.title: Seed cells for PI‑PLC and CPDY assays
steps.instruction: For PI‑PLC treatment plate 1 × 10⁵ cells in a 6 cm dish; for CPDY treatment plate 1 × 10⁶ cells in a 10 cm dish. Culture at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified chamber. Use HLE medium: DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1 % Pen‑Strep; AsPC‑1 medium: RPMI‑1640 + 10 % FBS + 1 % sodium pyruvate + 1 % Pen‑Strep. Warm PBS and culture medium to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Prepare PBS solution (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve in ddH₂O to make 1 L of PBS containing NaCl 137 mM (8 g), KCl 2.7 mM (0.2 g), Na₂HPO₄ 10 mM (1.44 g), KH₂PO₄ 1.8 mM (0.24 g). Store at room temperature (20‑25 °C); stable up to 3 months.

steps.title: Prepare PI‑PLC storage buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL of storage buffer with Tris‑HCl 10 mM (8 g), NaCl 144 mM (0.2 g), BSA 0.05 % (0.025 g), pH 7.4. Store at room temperature; stable up to 3 months.

steps.title: Make PI‑PLC stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve PI‑PLC to a final concentration of 1 unit / mL in the PI‑PLC storage buffer, aliquot, and store at –20 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Make CPDY stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve CPDY in 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5) to a final concentration of 1 unit / µL, aliquot, and store at –20 °C protected from light. Handle in a fume hood (skin/eye irritant).

steps.title: Add primary antibodies for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, then add 200 µL PBS containing mouse monoclonal 4H2 anti‑PrP (10 ng/µL) to the PI‑PLC‑treated tube and to an untreated control tube; add 200 µL PBS with isotype control mouse IgG1 (10 ng/µL) to a third tube. Incubate 4 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Wash cells after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash cells six times: add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, vortex briefly, centrifuge 300 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant each time. Aspirate carefully to avoid cell loss.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, vortex, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash a total of six times.

steps.title: Add fluorescent secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL PBS containing goat‑anti‑mouse AF488 (5 ng/µL), vortex briefly, and incubate 4 °C for 40 min in the dark.

steps.title: Wash cells after secondary incubation
steps.instruction: Wash cells six times as described for the primary wash (1 mL ice‑cold PBS, vortex, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant each time).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS, vortex, centrifuge 300 × g 3 min 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash a total of six times.

steps.title: Resuspend and filter cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in 200 µL ice‑cold PBS, filter through a 100‑mesh gauze net, and collect the filtrate in pre‑labelled FACS tubes (volume can be scaled as needed).

steps.title: Load supernatant onto antibody column
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 500 µL of clarified supernatant to a spin column pre‑loaded with aminolinked anti‑PrP antibody.

steps.title: Rotate column overnight at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Place the column on a rotator and incubate at 4 °C for at least 12 h (overnight).

steps.title: Centrifuge column and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash beads with lysis buffer six times
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL lysis buffer (Table 3) to the column, invert 10 times, centrifuge 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C, discard flow‑through; repeat this wash six times.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL lysis buffer, invert column 10×, centrifuge 1,000 × g 1 min 4 °C, discard flow‑through.
Repeat the wash a total of six times.

steps.title: Neutralize and pre‑elute column
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL neutralization buffer (Table 9) to the collection tube, then add 20 µL elution buffer (Table 10) directly to the column, incubate 5 s, and centrifuge 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Elute PrP with acidic buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer (Table 10) to the column, incubate 15 min at 4 °C without mixing, then centrifuge 1,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Repeat purification if eluate insufficient
steps.instruction: If the collected eluate is insufficient for downstream CPDY treatment, repeat the entire affinity‑purification procedure 2–3 times; also repeat if only 10–75 µg of antibody is available.

description:
CRITICAL: All materials used for cell culture need to be sterilized, and all procedures for handling cells need to be carried out in a Level II biosafety cabinet under standard aseptic techniques.
Note: This protocol has been successfully used for identifying the expression form of prion protein (PrP) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cells and melanoma cells.1,2 Here, we describe the detailed steps using hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cells as an example. But we expect this will be applicable to other cell lines. We describe two assays that are performed independently. For cell surface PI-PLC treatment assay, please refer to steps 1–15. For CPDY treatment assay, please refer to steps 16–48.
